rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unbiased view or a fact-based assessment.

example.english: I will take an objective view of the matter.
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 haak3 gun1 gam2 tai2 gin6 si6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a goal or target that someone is striving to achieve.

example.english: Our objective this year is to get a pay raise.
example.traditional: 我哋今年嘅目標係加薪。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 gaa1 san1

rows.note: Use this when the objective is framed as the purpose or intended outcome of an action or plan rather than as a measurable target.

example.english: The objective of doing this is to help him.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 zou6 ge3 muk6 dik1 hai6 bong1 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when objective means unbiased and the emphasis is on being impartial or fair rather than simply fact-based.

example.english: As a referee, you need to be objective and cannot favor either team.
example.traditional: 你做裁判要公正，唔可以偏袒任何一隊。
example.jyutping: nei5 zou6 coi4 pun3 jiu3 gung1 zing3 m4 ho2 ji5 pin1 taan2 jam6 ho4 jat1 deoi6
